description: MSVC 14.51 / Windows SDK 28000, with permanent user environment and version switching.

script: Write-Host 'This package downloads Microsoft MSVC and Windows SDK under the Microsoft license terms:'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'MSVC download/extraction failed. See the output above. Remove the failed Scoop install before retrying.' }

notes: Permanent user environment is configured for the active version. Reopen terminals.
Run msvc list to see installed versions and msvc use VERSION to switch.
Only the first installed version becomes active automatically; updating the active package refreshes its environment.
Run msvc-shell for the selected compiler, or use the version-specific developer-shell command.
Run msvc info to see compiler and SDK versions.
Uninstall restores owned environment settings when unchanged. Removing the active version clears the active selection.
If uninstall removes shared command shims, use scoop reset on a remaining MSVC package to restore them.
Scoop package versions identify the helper release; each manifest pins compiler/SDK selection and its Microsoft catalog URL.
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'MSVC configures the current user. Install without --global.' }
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not configure the permanent MSVC environment.' }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not restore the MSVC environment; uninstall has been stopped.' }
